original: Raw potato, sliced with a knife. Ready for the pan or the pot.
English: Raw potato, sliced with a knife. Ready for the pan or the pot.
German: Rohe Kartoffel, mit dem Messer geschnitten. Bereit für Pfanne oder Topf.

original: Diced tomato. The base of every sauce.
English: Diced tomato. The base of every sauce.

original: Carrot cut into pieces. For soups and stews.
English: Carrot cut into pieces. For soups and stews.
German: In Stücke geschnittene Karotte. Für Suppen und Eintöpfe.

original: Fresh milk. Spoils fast, but it is the start of every dairy product.
English: Fresh milk. Spoils fast, but it is the start of every dairy product.
German: Frische Milch. Verdirbt schnell, ist aber der Anfang jedes Milchprodukts.

original: Cream skimmed from milk. Churn it into butter or stir it into a sauce.
English: Cream skimmed from milk. Churn it into butter or stir it into a sauce.
German: Von der Milch abgerahmt. Zu Butter geschlagen oder in eine Sosse geruehrt.

original: A block of churned butter. Fries, bakes, and keeps far longer than cream.
English: A block of churned butter. Fries, bakes, and keeps far longer than cream.
German: Ein Stueck geschlagene Butter. Zum Braten und Backen, und weit haltbarer als Sahne.

original: Pressed cheese. Dense, filling, and the longest keeping dairy product.
English: Pressed cheese. Dense, filling, and the longest keeping dairy product.
German: Gepresster Kaese. Dicht, saettigend und das haltbarste Milchprodukt.

original: A single egg. Fry it, boil it, or work it into dough.
English: A single egg. Fry it, boil it, or work it into dough.
German: Ein einzelnes Ei. Braten, kochen oder in den Teig geben.

original: Damp, coarse salt straight from the boiling pan. Dry it before it is worth anything.
English: Damp, coarse salt straight from the boiling pan. Dry it before it is worth anything.
German: Feuchtes, grobes Salz direkt aus der Siedepfanne. Erst getrocknet ist es etwas wert.

original: Dried salt. Seasons, cures and preserves - and everyone wants it.
English: Dried salt. Seasons, cures and preserves - and everyone wants it.
German: Getrocknetes Salz. Wuerzt, poekelt, konserviert - und jeder will es haben.

original: Dried parsley. Keeps for a long time and goes into herb mix.
English: Dried parsley. Keeps for a long time and goes into herb mix.
German: Getrocknete Petersilie. Lange haltbar und Teil der Kraeutermischung.

original: Dried dill. For fish, potatoes and pickled food.
English: Dried dill. For fish, potatoes and pickled food.
German: Getrockneter Dill. Fuer Fisch, Kartoffeln und Eingelegtes.

original: Dried thyme. The heart of herb mix and hunter seasoning.
English: Dried thyme. The heart of herb mix and hunter seasoning.
German: Getrockneter Thymian. Das Herz von Kraeutermischung und Hunter Seasoning.

original: Dried rosemary. Rare, aromatic, for meat and bread.
English: Dried rosemary. Rare, aromatic, for meat and bread.
German: Getrockneter Rosmarin. Selten, aromatisch, fuer Fleisch und Brot.

original: Dried wild garlic. For sausage, meat and hunter seasoning.
English: Dried wild garlic. For sausage, meat and hunter seasoning.
German: Getrockneter Baerlauch. Fuer Wurst, Fleisch und Hunter Seasoning.

original: Dried paprika pods. A mortar turns them into powder.
English: Dried paprika pods. A mortar turns them into powder.
German: Getrocknete Paprikaschoten. Ein Moerser macht Pulver daraus.

original: Ground paprika. Sausage, goulash, chili, stews.
English: Ground paprika. Sausage, goulash, chili, stews.
German: Gemahlene Paprika. Wurst, Gulasch, Chili, Eintoepfe.

original: Dried peppercorns. Grind them in a mortar.
English: Dried peppercorns. Grind them in a mortar.

original: Ground black pepper. The rarest of the everyday spices.
English: Ground black pepper. The rarest of the everyday spices.
German: Gemahlener schwarzer Pfeffer. Das seltenste der alltaeglichen Gewuerze.

original: Thyme, parsley and rosemary, ground together.
English: Thyme, parsley and rosemary, ground together.
German: Thymian, Petersilie und Rosmarin, zusammen gemahlen.

original: Salt, pepper, paprika, thyme and wild garlic. For game and hunter dishes.
English: Salt, pepper, paprika, thyme and wild garlic. For game and hunter dishes.
German: Salz, Pfeffer, Paprika, Thymian und Baerlauch. Fuer Wild und Jaegergerichte.
